rationale: CR-001 resolved: the fix-up adds three tests covering the previously untested hops (_collect_server_results, _process_single_server_for_tools, _process_single_mcp_server), each asserting the kwarg is forwarded as True and as False, matching the source calls at toolkit_service.py lines 310, 350 and 805.
